title: Independently verify #7544’s conditional κ gain and owned1557 erasure boundary
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This independently verifies the finite conditional result in **#7544 at `d6be7d620c9c8337104daeb09fe01196eced5fe3`**: κ **0.003647969120276**, exact gain **0.000000888080587** over #7481. Construction credit stays with ToikY, DreamingOfClouds and the retained lineage. This review supplies no new numerical increase beyond #7544 and changes no selected frontier.

The separate rational checker compares **all 74 owned values immediately before CLEAR**. Exactly 73 agree with #7481. The one changed value, owned1557 at chart595, differs by `−3/2(e902+e985)`. It checks the numerical effect of all five subsequent reads: each target row is restored immediately after its ADD. Both source words already have 73 nonzero erasure operands. The complete public map, COPY guard, ordered owned lifecycle/MOVE stream, grid, mass, actual fixed17caller invoice and both directed prices are checked with separate implementations.

The complete source replay exposed a runtime portability failure: its original 595-second aggregate command timed out after the native kernel passed. This failed run remains in `evidence/`. The review factors the **unchanged** native and signed kernels into separate required cold commands. Each uses a new isolated source export. The fresh native mathematical receipt must equal the authenticated frozen receipt consumed by signed verification; all three commands are required and emit the same source/receipt binding. Only the source’s exact top-level timing omission lists are used. Actual fresh/frozen receipt hashes and all adapter records are retained. Signed alone is explicitly insufficient.

The five inherited premises remain `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, and `analytic_recovery`. In particular,1557’s operand is changed: the claim explicitly retains bounded arbitrary-content erasure. This is not an equal-operand restoration, compiled multiplier execution, independent human/formal-kernel approval, or maintainer admission.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision8, task `p104-side-correction`, scope key `4045f5fea37856e1d039`.

**Scope changed by explicit donor choice to verification of #7544 and a separate review PR** after that composition was published. No further numerical search or construction modification occurs. All-states PR7544 search, central review ledger and refreshed #7111/#1166 coordination were checked. Newer **#7546**, its role902 construction and other active/paused scopes remain outside this review.

The new audit reuses the unmodified generic dense `run()` and `require()` dependency from **#7164 at `190cf7eadc8dd8002327bec4b63d1db7f978a0e9`**. Its historical fixed-size `check()` and fixed-clock omission branches are unused. The exact74file #7544 export and actual transitive replay inputs are committed for Git-free cold availability; SOURCE-MAP.json and ORACLES.json bind every imported source byte. This is actual replay input, not an attribution-only copy.

Two existing CI prerequisites are kept as separate commits: selected-replay navigation and source-pinned historical replay. Their patches are reused from the prior #7147/#7257 lineage; neither changes the selected result.

## Validation

CPython3.12, NumPy1.26.4, assertions enabled. The supported registered invocation is:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-7544-independent-review
```

Required cold commands: `verify.py --stage native` (480s), `--stage signed` (495s), `--stage audit` (225s), with preparation and descendants included in each cap. Total cap1200s. Exact observed results and receipt binding are in EXECUTION.md.

**All three cold commands passed:** native351.326s, signed/final402.072s, independent audit60.936s; total814.334s. All emitted binding `3e9e4b83f85d4bc1a59d7f846dbfe826db414b8d83dd1d2c94b1aa81167ce4bc`. The separate metadata/pin check, six selected-navigation tests, committed-byte/mode/source-history preflight and committed export/offline integrity check also passed. Publication head: `e04613f0cdd715e4d6f44687234259d1b26368cc`. Hosted checks will be reported against that exact head.

The source’s original exact command passed79.2659s; its original complete command remains a595s timeout. An initial independent-control selector failure is also retained: the994instruction occurs twice, while #7542’s original `list.remove` control selects the first. The repaired control binds that same occurrence40962 by its exact unique neighbouring instructions. All seven retained corrupt-word controls, dirty COPY, insufficient odd/dyadic grid and omitted-paid-job control must reject.

The reused full kernels check the3039map catalogue and absolute phases,104main boundary pairs, complete signed caller, ordinary bound782757964, precision coefficient2430, grid/mass, tape/stock/compiler,54strict+4functional outer inequalities and the fixed-profile ceiling. These are finite conditional checks, not a proof of the five premises. No selected record was edited.

## Credit

ToikY/#7544 supplies the composition and complete application; DreamingOfClouds/#7542 supplies the helper rung merges (with disclosed Claude Code assistance); Clear1nsight/#7481 supplies the funded helper485 return; #7480/#7334 and earlier authors supply the native lineage; Rohan Arun/#7113 supplies the signed caller; ToikY/#7298 supplies the retained directed tariff. The dense oracle is earlier Clear1nsight work, not a newly invented separate author. All nested source notices are unchanged.

Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex and verified GPT-6 Pro5/5 assistance. The completed Pro consultation inspected the precise factoring/consumer contract; it did not execute kernels or confer independent human approval. See NOTICE and PRO-CONSULTATION.md.

## Open next questions

The smallest next step is maintainer assessment of this exact conditional application, especially the explicit owned-erasure reliance and required three-command receipt join. The five framework premises and maintainer selection remain outside this review’s finite verification. Stronger #7546 requires its own exact-source review. See TASK.json and the [canonical finding and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19598697).
